title: SmartAgri UGM Showcases Smart UAV Technology Innovation at BRIN Exhibition on Smart Technology (BEST) 2026
excerpt: Bandung, June 9, 2026 – Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) Universitas Gadjah Mada participated in the BRIN Exhibition on Smart Technology (BEST) 2026, organized by the Badan Riset dan Inovasi Nasional (BRIN) as part of the International Conference on Smart Mechatronics Engineering (ICSMech) 2026 at The…
body:
**Bandung, June 9, 2026** – Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) Universitas Gadjah Mada participated in the _BRIN Exhibition on Smart Technology_ (BEST) 2026, organized by Badan Riset dan Inovasi Nasional (BRIN) as part of the _International Conference on Smart Mechatronics Engineering_ (ICSMech) 2026 at The Trans Luxury Hotel, Bandung. At this event, SmartAgri showcased an innovation titled "_Smart UAV Technology: Remote Sensing for Precision Agriculture_", a technology for precision agricultural monitoring based on UAVs, remote sensing, and artificial intelligence.

The SmartAgri team participating in this exhibition consisted of **Mutiara Alifia Ramadhanty** as team leader and **Fahmi Arsyad, S.T.P.** as team member, under the supervision of **Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc.** The innovation presented is the result of research development within the Smart Agriculture Research Center, Department of Agricultural Engineering and Biosystems, Faculty of Agricultural Technology, Universitas Gadjah Mada.

Smart UAV Technology was developed to support precision agricultural monitoring through the utilization of UAVs, remote sensing technology, and artificial intelligence. This technology is designed to help identify plant conditions more quickly and accurately, including detecting plant stress indicators that are difficult to observe visually and monitoring large cultivation areas efficiently. At the BEST 2026 exhibition, the SmartAgri team showcased various UAV and AI-based technology developments that have been applied to various agricultural commodities, ranging from plant health monitoring, land condition analysis, to decision support systems. The presence of this innovation demonstrates the significant potential of digital technology in realizing a smarter, more efficient, and data-driven agricultural system.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/743-1-image-5-1030x773.webp)

Beyond serving as a platform for research dissemination, participation in BEST 2026 also provided an opportunity for the SmartAgri team to introduce various smart agricultural innovations to researchers, academics, industry practitioners, and stakeholders from various institutions. This activity also strengthened collaboration between Universitas Gadjah Mada and BRIN in developing UAV-based remote sensing technology to support the transformation of the agricultural sector toward the digital era and precision agriculture.

This activity aligns with several Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) through increased productivity and food security, SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure) through the development of UAV and artificial intelligence-based innovations, SDG 13 (Climate Action) through the implementation of more efficient and environmentally friendly agriculture, and SDG 15 (Life on Land) through support for sustainable land management via accurate and non-destructive plant monitoring technology.

original.body:
**Bandung, 9 Juni 2026** – Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) Universitas Gadjah Mada turut berpartisipasi dalam ajang _BRIN Exhibition on Smart Technology_ (BEST) 2026 yang diselenggarakan oleh Badan Riset dan Inovasi Nasional (BRIN) dalam rangkaian _International Conference on Smart Mechatronics Engineering_ (ICSMech) 2026 di The Trans Luxury Hotel, Bandung. Pada kegiatan ini, SmartAgri menampilkan inovasi dengan judul “_Smart UAV Technology: Remote Sensing for Precision Agriculture_”, teknologi pemantauan pertanian presisi berbasis UAV, penginderaan jauh, dan kecerdasan buatan.

Tim SmartAgri yang berpartisipasi dalam pameran ini terdiri atas **Mutiara Alifia Ramadhanty** sebagai ketua tim dan **Fahmi Arsyad, S.T.P.** sebagai anggota tim, di bawah supervisi **Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc.** Inovasi yang dipresentasikan merupakan hasil pengembangan riset di lingkungan Smart Agriculture Research Center, Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem, Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian Universitas Gadjah Mada.

Inovasi Smart UAV Technology dikembangkan untuk mendukung pemantauan pertanian presisi melalui pemanfaatan UAV, teknologi penginderaan jauh, dan kecerdasan buatan. Teknologi ini dirancang untuk membantu mengidentifikasi kondisi tanaman secara lebih cepat dan akurat, termasuk mendeteksi indikasi stres tanaman yang sulit diamati secara visual serta memantau area budidaya yang luas secara efisien. Dalam pameran BEST 2026, tim SmartAgri menampilkan berbagai pengembangan teknologi berbasis UAV dan AI yang telah diterapkan pada berbagai komoditas pertanian, mulai dari pemantauan kesehatan tanaman, analisis kondisi lahan, hingga sistem pendukung pengambilan keputusan. Kehadiran inovasi ini menunjukkan potensi besar teknologi digital dalam mewujudkan sistem pertanian yang lebih cerdas, efisien, dan berbasis data.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/743-1-image-5-1030x773.webp)

Selain sebagai sarana diseminasi hasil penelitian, partisipasi dalam BEST 2026 juga menjadi kesempatan bagi tim Smartagri untuk memperkenalkan berbagai inovasi pertanian cerdas kepada peneliti, akademisi, praktisi industri, serta pemangku kepentingan yang hadir dari berbagai institusi. Kegiatan ini sekaligus memperkuat kolaborasi antara Universitas Gadjah Mada dan BRIN dalam pengembangan teknologi penginderaan jauh berbasis UAV untuk mendukung transformasi sektor pertanian menuju era digital dan pertanian presisi.

Kegiatan ini sejalan dengan beberapa tujuan Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), khususnya SDG 2 (Zero Hunger)melalui peningkatan produktivitas dan ketahanan pangan, SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure) melalui pengembangan inovasi berbasis UAV dan kecerdasan buatan, SDG 13 (Climate Action) melalui penerapan pertanian yang lebih efisien dan ramah lingkungan, serta SDG 15 (Life on Land) melalui dukungan terhadap pengelolaan lahan yang berkelanjutan melalui teknologi pemantauan tanaman yang akurat dan non-destruktif.
